name: coolify-devops
description: Claude Code skills for operating a Coolify server through the Coolify MCP, with a tailnet-first hosting model. The hosting companion to AI Build Kit. Install with `npx skills add KasperHonore/coolify-devops` or as a Claude Code plugin.

scripts.validate:skills: for s in skills/*/; do npx --yes skills-ref@latest validate "$s" || exit 1; done
scripts.validate:plugin: claude plugin validate .claude-plugin/marketplace.json --strict && claude plugin validate .claude-plugin/plugin.json && claude plugin validate skills --strict
scripts.validate: npm run validate:skills && npm run validate:versions && npm run validate:index
